# gtk4's calendar shows the date `:value` is bound to, and follows it.
#
# The override selects the bound date on the calendar from an effect keyed on
# it, through sngl_calendar_select in the cgo preamble (gtk_calendar_select_day,
# which every GTK 4 has; 4.20 deprecates it for a setter the older ones lack).
# Before, the calendar only reported the day a user picked and never showed the
# program's, so a picker bound to a date opened on today. The snapshots are
# March 5 2024 as bound, then January 31 2023 after a click writes it.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=gtk4 app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'
exists app.sngl.snapshots/march.png
exists app.sngl.snapshots/january.png
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/march.png app.sngl.snapshots/january.png

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"
import time "sngl:time"

component main node {
    var picked option[time.date] = "2024-03-05"
    vbox {
        datepicker(:value=picked)
        button #jan(text="January", @click { picked = "2023-01-31" })
    }
}

func testShowsBoundDate(t Test, c main) {
    t.snapshot("march")
    c.jan.click()
    t.snapshot("january")
}

-- testrun/gtk4/go/app.sngl/main/1 --
